name: GO Top Pattern
description: To represent types of gene-related entities and their parts.
scenarios: A 'template for synthesis of G-rich strand of telomere DNA activity' must be part of a 'telomerase activity'. All 'templates for synthesis of G-rich strand of telomere DNA activity' are 'molecular functions'.
competency_questions: What are the possible most general supertypes for any type from the gene-related domain?; What entity is part of another entity in the gene-related domain?
